purpose: Confirm or refute inherited claims; no front-end redesign or default change

corpora.ETH80_EVAL75: Pinned ETH80-split-v1: 75 eval images, four classes, original 256-square RGB, no labels passed to the front end; explicitly a reconstructed split, not proof of identity with the historical corpus
corpora.ETH80_REF4: Four pinned 000-000 reference images, original 256-square RGB; explicitly NOT asserted identical to the undocumented historical four-frame sample
corpora.ETH80_REF4_96: Same four images, whole-image Lanczos resize to 96-square RGB; separate operating point, never pooled with original-resolution counts
corpora.ETH80_OBJECT1: The four object-1 instances in the pinned split: all 41 views each; descriptive junction stability, not a classifier accuracy claim
corpora.SYNTHETIC_CONTROLS: Procedural flat/oriented/noise images and one labelled polygon occlusion fixture, used only for falsification and perturbation controls
corpora.ETH80_OBJECT1_96: Apple object-1, all 41 ETH-80 views, whole-image Lanczos resize to 96-square RGB; descriptive junction stability only
corpora.SYNTHETIC_NINE: The nine registered synthetic scene pairs recovered from the pinned Percept4 export (tests_figground scenes/fresh_scenes); independent front-end probe, renderer truth used only for pair identity/role labels where stated

sampling.primary_native_frames: All 79 images in the eval and reference arms
sampling.filter_training_positives: Four class-level templates: positives are all reference+eval images of the class; negatives are all images of the other three classes. Leave-one-out was pre-registered initially but amended before filter measurement to four class-level templates to bound compute; no query-level accuracy is claimed
sampling.filter_training_negatives: For each class, every image of the other three classes
sampling.filter_training_graph_scope: Mapper._spatial_situation: capped 50-node live graph, with its induced edges and actual edge parameters; not the full uncapped window
sampling.population_and_presence: All detections and complete induced windows of primary native frames; graph nodes are deduplicated by product identity, detections are counted separately
sampling.perturbation_frames: First two eval images of each class, 96-square; eight images total
sampling.junction_frames: Apple object-1: all 41 views at 96-square (amended before junction measurement from four object-1 instances at native resolution to bound compute; minimum one-object requirement retained)
sampling.mi_frames: All 79 native frames; class label used only by the audit estimator, never by the front end
sampling.pair_frames: Nine registered synthetic pairs for Position correlation/ablation; ETH80_REF4 has six unordered pairs and is reported separately, never called nine

fixed_rules.tree_defaults: Read and record the actual shipped parameters, not the historical pin baseline
fixed_rules.new_switch_defaults: OFF; no switch selected by this Phase-0 audit
fixed_rules.fragment_correspondence: Same parent contour index and fragment index; report unmatched and changed-parent counts, do not nearest-match signatures
fixed_rules.perturbation_correspondence: For translations, exact anchor-key equality; unmatched counts reported; for junction views, same-object nearest position with explicit distance, no class-label matching
fixed_rules.fragment_coordinate_drift: Euclidean distance of _frag_mid after removing the known translation; report median, p95, maximum, and signature-change counts; UNKNOWN if no matches
fixed_rules.occlusion_fixture: One fixed nonconvex polygon; remove the central 20 percent of its width over full height; same renderer, same front-end defaults; report contour fragmentation and coordinate drift separately
fixed_rules.isotropic_orientation: Flat grey control has zero image gradient; constant nonzero image also checked; noise is a negative control, not assumed perfectly isotropic
fixed_rules.joint_MI: Per lens kind, joint discrete emitted signature quantized tuple; per signature class, joint quantized tuple plus population presence pattern. Product graph-node observations, not independent-pixel p-values. Missing class means ABSENT, not a zero measurement
fixed_rules.MI_permutation_unit: Entire image: permute image class labels while keeping all its node signatures together; also report class-stratified node-label shuffle as a conditional diagnostic
fixed_rules.MI_p_value: (1 + count(null_MI >= observed_MI)) / (1000 + 1); descriptive, no causal or independence guarantee
fixed_rules.entropy: Shannon entropy of the complete emitted slot tuple per lens/class; report per-slot marginals and constant slots, and population-presence entropy separately
fixed_rules.distance_distribution: Continuous writer arguments intercepted without changing return values, grouped by edge family and slot; report min, median, p95, max and fraction outside declared schema span
fixed_rules.margin_rule: Read each Gabor channel's actual nonzero kernel support, compute its half-support, then apply the shipped interior cap. Report 256-square and 96-square separately. Pre-register only the rule, not a desired margin
fixed_rules.topological_bin_stability: Existing relation-class and categorical identity tuple agreement for corresponding anchors under the registered +/-2px translations; geometric stability is quantized graded-slot agreement
fixed_rules.template_attribute_share: Node-count share and mass share in structural_intersection output under both median-exemplar OFF and ON
fixed_rules.degree_zero_share: Unique graph nodes with zero incident edges divided by all nodes in the same named graph scope
fixed_rules.position_ablation: On each of the nine reference pairs, compare default correspondence with (a) Position lens nodes removed, (b) anchor coordinates removed, (c) both removed; report pair-set Jaccard and score deltas. No demotion decision in Phase 0
fixed_rules.constants: All production constants remain unchanged. Audit seeds, image sizes, perturbation sizes and sampling rules are fixed here before result production; no result-dependent thresholds
fixed_rules.determinism: PYTHONHASHSEED=0; canonical integer/enum-value/string sorts; no wall-clock-limited solver; fixed-count permutation test
